notes.title: Update 2.2.0 - Steam Deck Verified ✅
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37917423/8199c0098e30bf7ef5ee4099f59d67917d65516a.jpg[/img]

Ruggnar will have a major update including the [b]Steam Deck Verification[/b] ✅!

Many improvements, additions and fixes in this [b]update 2.2.0[/b], you can find the patch notes bellow.

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] Creation of new versions of the lairs.
[*] A new lair has been added and is unlocked upon finishing the game.
[*] A note now appears on the floor of the lair when the game is completed. This note allows you to move to the lair of your choice.
[*] New items available for purchase at the merchant:
[*] 3 upgrades for Fluffy.
[*] A keyring to keep your keys even after death.
[*] A wooden purse to preserve your hard-earned coins even after death.
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Shields bought from the merchant now appear in the UI. You can now see if they are still available.
[*] Cinematics that have already been played will no longer play when retrying the level. However, you can still watch them in the lair.
[*] The cinematics for the encounter with the second boss can now be skipped, making retries less annoying.
[*] After defeating the first chapter’s boss for the first time, you are now redirected to the lair.
[*] The water tanks in the last encounter now have a progress bar showing the water level.
[*] The old merchant now appears on every even floor, as long as you haven’t already picked 3 modifiers.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Throwing a candle onto a coin, when in possession of the proper upgrade, now correctly collects the coin.
[*] The "25km" achievement, which could previously be missed, is now properly awarded.
[*] A system has been added to check for and unlock any missed achievements.
[*] Music should no longer stop working in a specific situation.
[*] The Discord link has been removed from the main menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0 and better experience on Steam Deck !
notes.content:
Ruggnar is fully playable on Steam Deck without any tweak.
Select it on your library and enjoy it on the go!

Many improvements, additions and fixes in this update : 

Fix :
[ALL] Fix Gold coin achievements
[ALL] A beard dye was missing on the level selection screen
[ALL] Bosses tracks was still playing when level was restarted
[ALL] Fix a collision problem with the sliding bridge
[ALL] Fix some visual artifact in procgen mode
[ALL] Fix bottom line of the scene
[ALL] Fix the climbing the ladder
[ALL] Fix an issue when opening the book of chapter 1 to try again level 2

Add : 
[ALL] Add the total number of accidents in the stats book
[ALL] Added objects to found on the overview when starting a level

Improvement :
[ALL] Improve readability in the lower buffet

notes.title: Update 1.0.003

[PC] Key remap for directions now works as expected

[ALL] Fix some typo in english

[ALL] Shorten the time for the popup to appear to remember to change the candle
[ALL] Better light glow
